summary: DNS of the cylinder wake at Re = 180 from a uniform flow to t = 300. It gives the seed of the periodic-orbit stage.
description: DNS of the Re = 180 cylinder wake from a uniform flow to t = 300, with the periodic shedding developed. The stage writes the start fields of the later stages; its reference checks that the run reached its end time with the flow in the expected state: the norms of the last snapshot to the stated tolerance. The values are those of the run named under produced.
